title: Finite-stage model of a finitely presented affine algebra
statement:
Let $I$ be a nonempty directed set, let $(A_\lambda)_{\lambda\in I}$ be a directed system of rings with transition maps $\varphi_{\lambda\mu}\colon A_\lambda\to A_\mu$ ($\lambda\leq\mu$) and colimit $A$, with structure maps $\varphi_\lambda\colon A_\lambda\to A$; write $S_\lambda=\operatorname{Spec}(A_\lambda)$ and $S=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$, so that $(S_\lambda)$ is an inverse system with affine transition morphisms and $S=\varprojlim S_\lambda$. Fix $\lambda_0\in I$ and a finite presentation

$$
B=A[x_1,\ldots,x_n]/(r_1,\ldots,r_m).
$$

Let $c_1,\ldots,c_N\in A$ be the finitely many coefficients of $r_1,\ldots,r_m$. By finite-data descent [lemma-nagata-filtered-colimit-finite-data] (equivalently, because $A=\operatorname{colim}A_\lambda$), for each $k$ there exist a stage $\lambda_k\in I$ and an element $\tilde c_k\in A_{\lambda_k}$ with $\varphi_{\lambda_k}(\tilde c_k)=c_k$. **Choose** such pairs $(\lambda_k,\tilde c_k)$; they are not unique, and everything below depends on this choice (and on the presentation); citers must not assume the result is independent of it. Let $F=\{\lambda_0,\lambda_1,\ldots,\lambda_N\}\subseteq I$ and let $\lambda_B=u(F)$ be the selected upper bound of [def-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound]; by [lemma-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound], $\lambda_0\leq\lambda_B$ and $\lambda_k\leq\lambda_B$ for all $k$. Let $r_{j,\lambda_B}\in A_{\lambda_B}[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ be the polynomial obtained from $r_j$ by replacing each coefficient $c_k$ by $\varphi_{\lambda_k\lambda_B}(\tilde c_k)$, and define

$$
B_{\lambda_B}
=A_{\lambda_B}[x_1,\ldots,x_n]/
(r_{1,\lambda_B},\ldots,r_{m,\lambda_B}).
$$

Since $\varphi_{\lambda_B}\circ\varphi_{\lambda_k\lambda_B}=\varphi_{\lambda_k}$, the map $\varphi_{\lambda_B}$ applied to coefficients sends $r_{j,\lambda_B}$ to $r_j$. Define $\beta_B$ to be the $A$-algebra map

$$
\beta_B\colon B_{\lambda_B}\otimes_{A_{\lambda_B}}A
=A[x_1,\ldots,x_n]/(\varphi_{\lambda_B}(r_{1,\lambda_B}),\ldots,\varphi_{\lambda_B}(r_{m,\lambda_B}))
\longrightarrow B
$$

sending $x_i\mapsto x_i$ (here the two quotients have the same relations, so $\beta_B$ is the identity on presentations). Since $\lambda_0\leq\lambda_B$, $\operatorname{Spec}(B_{\lambda_B})$ is a scheme over $S_{\lambda_B}$ and hence over $S_{\lambda_0}$; for $\lambda_B\leq\lambda$ the base changes $\operatorname{Spec}(B_{\lambda_B}\otimes_{A_{\lambda_B}}A_\lambda)$ form the base-changed system of [def-nagata-basechanged-system] (started at $\lambda_B$), whose limit term is $\operatorname{Spec}(B_{\lambda_B}\otimes_{A_{\lambda_B}}A)$.
